fits.fact: Fits external canister filters with 12/16 mm or 16/22 mm hoses. Examples given are the Eheim Classic 250/350 (12/16), Oase BioMaster (16/22) and Eheim Classic 600 (mixed set). Check your filter's hose size before ordering.
The intake has narrow slots that help keep small fish and shrimp out of the filter, which suits shrimp and nano-fish tanks.
The Premium outlet's skimmer uses the water flow to clear surface film, so a planted tank may not need a separate skimmer.
Retailers list it as compatible with filters such as the UNS Delta 60/90, Eheim 2215, Zoo Med 511 and ADA Super Jet ES-600.

usage.fact: You can cut the pipes shorter with a small saw or pipe cutter. Plan the final length before cutting.
The inlet and outlet heads come off the pipes, which makes cleaning easier.
Every joint can be taken apart. The PETG looks a little cloudy out of the box but turns clear once it is underwater.
Mount the pipes on the tank rim with the 2 included Neo Holder clamps, then turn the outlet head to set the flow direction.

issues.fact: PETG doesn't shatter, but retailers warn that the pipes and the skimmer can crack if handled with too much force.

One forum user said a fish got pulled into the gap between a skimmer and the inflow pipe. The same user said skimmer parts turn hazy from micro-scratches after repeated cleaning and can crack where the pieces push together. The post doesn't clearly name the product.
Reviews on one EU retailer average about 4.7/5 from 39 ratings, but one buyer harshly criticised the plastic.
Version difference: Premium adds the skimmer and reliever over Normal/Standard. The Ver.2 sets are the current ones sold in Europe.
Stock is patchy in Vietnam: Greendeal and Cửa Hàng Thủy Sinh both show it as out of stock.

alternatives.model: In out Inox có lọc váng phi 12
alternatives.why: Cheaper (400,000₫) and in stock. It is 304 stainless steel with a built-in surface skimmer, so it won't scratch or crack like plastic, but it is not transparent.

alternatives.model: IN OUT Inox MAD F12 (phi 12 / phi 16)
alternatives.why: Much cheaper, at about 260,000–280,000₫. It is 304 stainless steel with a 360° rotating outlet and an inlet with a cleaning button.
A branded stainless-steel option that holds up better than plastic. Vietnamese prices weren't found; in Europe it costs about €55–69.
